parameters.query:
WITH target AS (SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1),
   user_sessions AS (SELECT session_id FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $1),
   del_history AS (DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM user_sessions) OR session_id = $2),
   del_otp AS (DELETE FROM otp WHERE email IN (SELECT email FROM target)),
   del_request AS (DELETE FROM delete_requests WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM user_sessions) OR session_id = $2),
   del_flow AS (DELETE FROM auth_flow WHERE email IN (SELECT email FROM target) OR session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM user_sessions))
   DELETE FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target) RETURNING id;
